# Motopedia

> Motopedia is a free, open motorcycle encyclopedia and course by Transitions Lab: how motorcycles work (petrol and electric), how to diagnose faults, repair them and find spare parts, with interactive 3D tools. Text and figures are CC BY-SA 4.0.

Written in plain English for riders, mechanics, trainers and fleet operators. Reference values come from a fuel-injected 125 cc single (the K-Light 125); always check your own bike's manual.

## Course

- [Course overview](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/learn/): six modules with live figures and a check at the end of every chapter
- [Crash course](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/crash-course/): the whole motorcycle in 15 minutes
- [Module 1: Foundations: the machine, its anatomy and the workshop](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/learn/#foundations)
- [Module 2: The engine: four-stroke and two-stroke](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/learn/#engine)
- [Module 3: Fuel, air and exhaust](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/learn/#fuel)
- [Module 4: Electrical systems: ignition, battery, charging and lighting](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/learn/#electrics)
- [Module 5: Drivetrain and chassis](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/learn/#drivetrain-chassis)
- [Module 6: Electric motorcycles](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/learn/#electric)
- [Quiz](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/quiz/): questions for every module

## Repair

- [Repair home](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/repair/): search any problem, part or job
- [Diagnose a problem](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/repair/diagnose/): three questions to the likely fault
- [Problems by symptom](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/repair/problems/): step-by-step checks
- [Repairs](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/repair/repairs/): jobs from rider level to workshop
- [Parts](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/repair/parts/): what each part does and how it fails
- [Repairs by bike](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/repair/bikes/): 500 motorcycles and scooters with specs, top repairs and problems

## Spare parts

- [Spare parts](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/parts/): what wears, replacement intervals, typical prices and where to buy, per model

## Tools

- [3D Overview](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/overview/): interactive motorcycle parts diagram
- [Cockpit](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/cockpit/): ride the bike, start it, run the dyno
- [Under the Engine](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/engine/): 3D 125 cc engine, gearbox and clutch
- [Wiring Lab](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/wiring/): harness, starting, charging and ignition circuits
- [Bike builder](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/build/): assemble a bike and change its specification
- [Motorcycle types](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/types/) and [History](https://motobike-five.vercel.app/history/)
